responsibility: Declares the core enumerations, constants, and target-configuration data structures used across the LoongArch backend. It assigns stable numeric codes for ISA bases, FPU extensions, ABI variants, code models, machine-option switches, and CPU types, and defines struct loongarch_isa, struct loongarch_abi, and struct loongarch_target along with extern declarations for the parallel property tables populated in loongarch-def.c.
same_name_distinction: Defines the canonical enums, structs, constants, and extern declarations that describe LoongArch target properties across the backend. Unlike loongarch-def.c, it does not instantiate the tables; it establishes their shared schema and numeric codes.
